desc:
Welcome to Glory Kill Testing, a simulator game about spilling the blood of your foes in horrific ways... zombies. Why do you fight against endless hordes? Who cares! You have plenty of weapons you can use to kill the zombies that surround you, from a Chainsaw to the Slayer's Super Shotgun. 
Join the Glory Kill Testing Community for an MP5 and a Musket: https://www.roblox.com/groups/14792838/Glory-Kill-Testing-Fan-Group-WE-ARE-BACK

This game is intended for 60 FPS, the code is a nightmare. 
Consoles press X or Square to reload, depending on device.
